review_candidates.title: Senior Data Engineer
review_candidates.description: 📈 Who We Are: We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair. We're rebuilding how energy is bought and sold. That means cutting out middlemen, connecting businesses directly with renewable generators, and ensuring every transaction is traceable and transparent . We're a 160+ person team - operators, data scientists, engineers, customer champions and energy experts - backed by top-tier investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Hitachi Ventures, Allianz, AlbionVC and Atomico. We closed a $75M Series B round in early 2026, taking our total funding to $94M, and we now power energy for over 4,000 UK businesses across 8,500+ sites , with over £75m in value returned to businesses and generators so far. We're a technology company solving the energy industry, not an energy company. Some people call us a neo-utility, the neo-bank idea, applied to energy. The industry is noticing. We were crowned Europe's Most Exciting Tech Company at the GP Bullhound Allstars awards, came in at #6 on LinkedIn's Top Startups 2026 in the UK, #7 on the Scaling Europe 50 of Europe's fastest-growing companies, and #14 on Sifted's AI 100. Learn more about us on our website. The Role We're hiring a Senior Data Engineer . Data sits at the core of what tem does. Our time-series data is the spine that runs from pricing through to billing: every transaction depends on it working. You'll be working across a genuinely varied set of workloads: textual data, time-series data, and event streams, each with its own ingestion and reliability challenges, including TSDS. You'll join our Data Service team of 4, owning the design, reliability, and recovery strategy of specific ingestion pipelines and systems end-to-end. This is an individual contributor role: no team to manage, full ownership of the work you do. The team has more work than hands right now, and this role exists to close that gap so the business can move faster on the data it depends on. You'll also work closely with our AI initiatives as they grow: the platform you own increasingly becomes the foundation those efforts depend on. You will: Own the design, reliability, and recovery strategy for the ingestion pipelines and systems in your domain. Maintain and improve the data platform, including working through the existing tech debt backlog. Build monitoring and alerting so issues surface before they become incidents. Set the data quality checks that make an SLA commitment possible, and hold the line on them. Help take the number of data products with a defined SLA from 2 to 10. Responsibilities Data Ingestion Own the design, reliability, and resilience of ingestion pipelines end-to-end, including TSDS, with a clear recovery strategy when things break. Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines for new and existing data sources. Decide the right approach (batch vs. streaming) for each pipeline in your domain, including high-scale, low-latency requirements for time-series data. Set data quality checks that make an SLA commitment possible, and hold the line on them. Platform Maintenance Own the day-to-day reliability of the data platform: monitoring, testing, and fixing issues before they become firefights. Own code quality and standards for the systems you're responsible for, including CI checks (linting, tests, coverage). Work through the existing tech debt backlog, prioritising fixes that unblock SLA commitments. Optimise pipelines for performance and cost as data volumes grow. Handle the failure modes specific to energy data: late arrivals, reprocessing, backfills. Monitoring & Alerting Build and improve observability across your systems so problems surface before they cause downstream impact. Set up alerting tied to the SLAs the team is committing to. Investigate and resolve issues within your domain, escalating genuinely cross-system problems. Supporting Expansion Help scope and prepare the platform for new data sources tied to international expansion. Flag where current architecture won't hold up as scope grows, even if fixing it isn't your call to make alone. Work closely with the AI team as their data needs on the platform grow. Requirements Must haves Strong Python skills, with proven experience building and maintaining production data pipelines. Experience owning the design, reliability, and resilience of a data pipeline or system end-to-end, not just writing pipeline code. AWS or GCP experience. Great communication skills, comfortable working directly with stakeholders to scope and agree SLAs, and explaining technical trade-offs to non-technical audiences. Strong team player, comfortable working independently against a backlog and making judgement calls on prioritisation, while fitting into an existing team of 4. Terraform experience. Bonus points Experience with time-series data at scale. Experience with modern data stack tooling (Airflow, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, ClickHouse). Experience in energy or climate tech. Background in high-growth startups or scale-ups. Genuine interest in how AI tooling and workflows intersect with data engineering. We're open to someone who doesn't tick every box here, as long as they bring solid AWS or GCP experience and the ability to own their own work end-to-end. Benefits & Perks Salary aligned to internal benchmarks and reviewed twice a year. Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission. 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off. Remote first and flexible working, with clear core hours and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons. Home working and wellbeing budgets: Up to GBP1,200 or EUR1,200 per year for your remote setup. Up to GBP150 or EUR150 per month for wellbeing. Interview Process We move fast. Most processes take 2 to 3 weeks from first chat to offer. If you need us to adapt anything, let us know. Intro call with Talent, 30 minutes. Behavioural interview, 60 minutes. Skills interview with cross-functional leaders, 60 to 90 minutes, including a practical exercise. Bar Raiser interview with leadership stakeholders, 45 minutes. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for. Compensation Range: £82,700 - £93,350

review_candidates.title: Senior Backend Engineer
review_candidates.description: About MD Integrations At MD Integrations , we partner with digital health brands to power clinical care at scale. We specialize in men's and women’s health, dermatology, endocrinology, and weight management, offering telehealth solutions that help patients receive expert, personalized care—all from the comfort of their home. Join our team and be part of the movement to make specialty care more accessible and impactful. MD Integrations is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We are unable to support US visa sponsorship at this time. Backend Engineer (PHP / Laravel) The Backend Engineer (PHP / Laravel) designs, develops, and maintains scalable and reliable server-side applications to ensure the highest standard of system performance and stability. As a Backend Engineer, you will take ownership of features and services, troubleshoot complex issues, optimize existing code, and contribute to architectural decisions. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including front-end dev, product, QA, and DevOps, collaborating both synchronously and asynchronously to deliver high-quality software, efficiently. We are looking for a skilled, detail-oriented engineer who is comfortable with full-stack collaboration, enjoys solving challenging problems, and thrives in a remote-first, fast-paced environment. Key Responsibilities Design, build, and optimize high-throughput RESTful APIs in PHP using the Laravel framework, writing efficient PostgreSQL queries and schema designs to support data-intensive clinical workflows. Contribute to new feature development and platform improvements within an Agile/Scrum process. Build and maintain integrations with third-party APIs and internal services, deploying and running services in Docker containers across AWS (or comparable cloud) environments to ensure secure, reliable data exchange. Write automated tests (unit, integration, and API-level) for PHP/Laravel back-end functionality and critical clinical workflows, and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines using Git/GitHub-based workflows and Docker to enable continuous testing and faster, more reliable releases. Write and maintain clear technical documentation for troubleshooting guides, fixes, API integrations, and support processes, version-controlled through Git/GitHub for easy team access and updates. Monitor application health, performance, and error logs using tools such as Rollbar and AWS CloudWatch to proactively identify and address potential issues before they affect patients or providers. Identify, document, and track software defects, analyzing logs and debugging to pinpoint root causes, and work with the development team within Agile/Scrum sprints to prioritize and ensure timely resolution. Actively participate in code reviews to uphold coding standards and engineering best practices. Continuously evaluate and improve our development processes, CI/CD pipelines, and tooling (Docker, monitoring/logging systems, cloud infrastructure) to enhance team efficiency, code quality, and release velocity. Identify opportunities to formalize and document internal processes, workflows, and troubleshooting playbooks, building a knowledge base that supports faster onboarding and more consistent support. Your Qualifications 8-10+ years of professional experience with PHP and Laravel framework. Experience working with AWS services like Lambdas, SES, Workers, etc. Solid knowledge of RESTful APIs, with ability to write automated API tests. Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent combination of education and experience. Deep experience with SQL databases (preferably PostgreSQL), including schema design, queries, and performance optimization. Ability to use AI tools to boost productivity but does not rely on it to be able to perform. Experience working with version control systems (Git) and collaborative workflows (GitHub), including CI/CD pipelines and ability to integrate automated tests into the deployment process. Experience with Docker Knowledge of monitoring tools (e.g., Rollbar, CloudWatch, etc.) Located in the US and able to work full-time for a US employer without requiring visa sponsorship. E-Verify is used during new hire onboarding to confirm work authorization status. Your Work DNA User-Centric: A genuine passion for helping customers succeed and a commitment to providing exceptional customer service. Proactive and Solution-Oriented: A proactive approach to identifying and resolving potential issues before they escalate. Team Player: Ability to work effectively as part of a team and collaborate with team members across different departments. Passion for Learning: A strong desire to learn and stay up-to-date on the latest trends and developments in telehealth and healthcare technology. What We Offer Competitive Salary: The targeted range for this role is $140,000 to $175,000 per year commensurate with qualifications and experience. Comprehensive Benefits Package: Our benefits package includes 75% subsidized health insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, paid time off, and a 401(k) plan with company match. Professional Development Opportunities: We are committed to investing in our employees' professional development and offer a variety of on the job training and development opportunities. Flexible Work Arrangements: We are a fully remote team who collaborate both synchronously and asynchronously to achieve the best outcomes. Collaborative and Supportive Work Environment: We foster a collaborative and supportive work environment where employees are encouraged to share ideas and contribute to the company's success.

review_candidates.title: Sr. Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: FORTNA partners with the world’s leading brands to transform omnichannel and parcel distribution operations. Known world-wide for enabling companies to keep pace with digital disruption and growth objectives, we design and deliver solutions, powered by intelligent software, to optimize fast, accurate and cost-effective order fulfillment and last mile delivery. Our people, innovative approach and proprietary algorithms and tools ensure optimal operations design and material and information flow. We deliver exceptional value every day to our customers with comprehensive services and products including network strategy, distribution center operational design and implementation, material handling automated equipment, robotics and a comprehensive suite of lifecycle services. At FORTNA, we believe in fostering a workplace that isn't just a job but a movement – a collective effort to redefine success and transform challenges into opportunities. "Join the Movement" encapsulates our commitment to a workplace culture that thrives on collaboration, celebrates diversity, and empowers every individual to contribute to something greater than themselves. Our Team. Our Passion. Our Approach. PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE: Goal Ownership: Take responsibility for individual and department goals as agreed upon with the Software Manager. Advanced Troubleshooting & Solutions: Perform in-depth troubleshooting and implement permanent solutions for recurring issues. System Expertise & Incident Management: Demonstrate a strong understanding of Warehouse Execution Systems (WES) / Warehouse Control Systems (WCS) to ensure timely resolution of critical incident tickets (P1/P2) while documenting resolution steps and conducting Root Cause Analysis (RCA). Stakeholder Communication & Accountability: Maintain availability, accountability, and clear communication with customers and key stakeholders when clarifying, investigating, and resolving escalated incident tickets. Flexible Shift Work: Ensure adherence to the flexible shift schedule, where team members work five days per week, totaling 40 hours, with two days off - one on the weekend and one on a weekday. This structure helps maintain sufficient resource availability, including during holidays and weekends, while ensuring software support coverage 16/7 (16 hours per day, 7 days per week). Mentorship & Support: Guide and mentor Junior Software Engineers on troubleshooting and resolving incident tickets. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS: Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field. Technical Expertise: At least 5 years of experience in Java, enterprise application development, and concurrent programming. Language Proficiency: Proficiency in English. Troubleshooting & Development: Experience in technical troubleshooting and software development. Technology Stack: Experience with Linux, Docker, Oracle, PostgreSQL, and Microservices. Communication & Collaboration: Excellent oral and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts to project members and stakeholders; must be a team player who collaborates well with both technical and non-technical resources. Soft Skills: Strong interpersonal, organizational, time management, and problem-solving skills. Maintenance Experience (Plus): Prior experience working on maintenance projects or customer support is a plus

review_candidates.title: Senior Backend Engineer 2
review_candidates.description: About HeyMarvin HeyMarvin is one of the fastest-growing research platforms in the galaxy. Some of the largest companies (such as Microsoft, Best Buy, LinkedIn, Sonos, and 7-11) use HeyMarvin as their secret weapon for building customer-centric solutions. Funded by notable investors like OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and first PayPal board member Scott Banister, HeyMarvin is an AI-native research system that integrates all your customer feedback and research into one central, searchable hub — so anyone can get the answers they need, when they need them. We are headquartered in Oakland, CA, with more than 100 passionate employees across three countries. We're united by our mission: To build a future where every strategic business decision is grounded in the voice of the customer. For more info, visit www.heymarvin.com. About The Role We are looking for an experienced Backend Engineer to join a fast-growing, well-funded Silicon Valley–based startup. This role offers a high level of ownership, autonomy, and the opportunity to work in a collaborative, high-performance environment with competitive compensation. Key Responsibilities Design, develop and deploy backend services with a focus on high availability, low latency and scalability Architect Distributed Systems: Design and implement robust microservices using Golang and Django that can handle concurrent processing of high-volume research data (e.g., video, audio, and large-scale text datasets). Optimize AI Workflows: Build and refine asynchronous task queues (using tools like Celery or Redis) to manage long-running AI inference tasks without impacting the responsiveness of the user-facing API. Database Performance: Design and maintain efficient schemas for both relational databases (PostgreSQL) and specialized storage (Vector databases for AI search), ensuring millisecond-level query performance as data scales into the millions of records. Load Management: Implement caching strategies and rate-limiting to protect service integrity during traffic spikes from global enterprise customers. Build and operate infrastructure, toolset and deployment pipelines Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Own and automate the provisioning of cloud resources on AWS (using Terraform or CloudFormation) to ensure environments are reproducible and scalable. CI/CD Optimization: Streamline the path from "code commit" to "production" by building automated testing and deployment pipelines that allow the team to ship multiple times a day with high confidence. Observability & Monitoring: Implement comprehensive logging, tracing, and alerting (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, or Datadog) to proactively identify performance bottlenecks and system health issues before they affect users. Developer Experience: Create internal CLI tools or scripts to simplify the local development environment and improve the velocity of the entire engineering team. Collaborate with other engineers to create beautiful products API Stewardship: Design clean, well-documented, and intuitive RESTful or GraphQL APIs that enable frontend teams to build seamless and high-performance user interfaces. Full-Stack Synergy: Work closely with product designers and frontend engineers to understand the "Jobs to be Done," ensuring that backend logic perfectly supports complex research workflows. Technical Mentorship: Participate in rigorous code reviews and architectural whiteboarding sessions, fostering a culture of high-quality code and continuous learning. Rapid Prototyping: Transition quickly from experimental AI features to production-ready services, balancing speed-to-market with long-term code maintainability. Handling and owning security and compliance aspects for the software that the team produces. Enterprise-Grade Compliance: Build and enforce the technical controls necessary to maintain SOC2, GDPR, or HIPAA compliance, ensuring customer data is treated with the highest level of privacy. Data Isolation: Implement strict multi-tenant architecture patterns to ensure that sensitive research insights from one organization (e.g., Microsoft) are never accessible or leaked to another (e.g., 7-11). Proactive Security: Conduct regular vulnerability scanning, dependency audits, and security reviews of the codebase to defend against OWASP Top 10 threats. IAM & Encryption: Manage complex Identity and Access Management (IAM) roles and ensure all sensitive data is encrypted both at rest and in transit. Qualifications 4-6 years of experience in backend engineering Strong skills in: Python (Django) Golang Problem-solving and debugging API development and database management Good To Have Familiarity with DevOps practices (Docker, AWS, CI/CD) Experience building scalable and distributed systems Strong ownership mindset with the ability to work independently Practical, solution-oriented thinker comfortable in fast-paced, low-process environments Why Join Us? Joining HeyMarvin as a Senior Software Engineer means being part of a high-growth, transparent, and empowering environment where your work has direct impact. You’ll collaborate with talented teammates, work with modern technologies, and help build a world-class product at the intersection of AI, research, and enterprise software-while having the autonomy to shape both your role and the company’s future. About The Team You’ll be joining a lean, high-performing team that values ownership, speed, and thoughtful execution. The team operates with minimal bureaucracy and emphasizes collaboration, continuous learning, and delivering meaningful outcomes. Compensation ₹30LPA, plus benefits.

review_candidates.description: Company Description Signalz builds advanced capital markets software for family offices, investment firms, banks, and professional market participants. The company develops intelligent systems that help financial organizations identify opportunities, monitor portfolios, analyze securities, and make faster, better-informed investment decisions. Its platform combines market data, analytics, automation, and decision-support technology into solutions tailored to real capital markets workflows. Signalz focuses on improving how clients manage risk, analyze market signals, support portfolio and advisory decisions, and streamline research and operations. With deep expertise in financial institutions and professional investing, Signalz aims to give investment professionals smarter software, sharper insights, and a stronger decision-making edge. Role Description This is a full-time hybrid role for a Junior Web Developer based in Tel Aviv District, Israel, with some flexibility for working from home. The Junior Web Developer will assist in building and maintaining web applications that support capital markets workflows, working closely with senior developers and product teams. Day-to-day tasks include implementing front-end interfaces, contributing to back-end services and APIs, fixing bugs, and participating in code reviews. The role also involves translating design specifications into responsive web pages, writing clean and maintainable code, and collaborating with QA to ensure application reliability. The Junior Web Developer will be encouraged to learn new technologies, follow secure coding practices, and contribute to continuous improvement of the development process. Qualifications Strong foundation in Web Development and Programming, including familiarity with modern web frameworks and languages. Front-End Development skills, such as building responsive user interfaces, working with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, and basic Web Design awareness. Back-End Web Development capabilities, including working with APIs, server-side logic, and databases. Understanding of usability and Web Design principles relevant to professional financial software. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. Ability to learn quickly, follow coding standards, and collaborate in a team-based development environment. Good communication skills in English; familiarity with financial or capital markets concepts is an advantage. Experience with version control (e.g., Git) and basic testing practices is beneficial.
